SSRF allowlist permits a loopback mock server while private-network protection remains enabled

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"ssrf\":{\"allowlist\":[{\"type\":\"cidr\",\"value\":\"127.0.0.0/8\"}],\"deny_private\":true,\"max_redirects\":5},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.status_code);
    println!("{:?}", result.metadata.title);
}
```
